label: Agent Ops & Evals
blurb: Plans an evaluation, reads a trace when another agent misbehaves, lays benchmark numbers into a table, and reviews an MCP connector before install. It tests other agents. It does not raise a score the run did not produce, and it does not declare a model the winner from a single example.
